integrity: The proof combines the published description of the wobbly divisor and first/group homology with an explicit intersection-graph calculation for the sixteen exceptional curves, Euler additivity, affineness of the discriminant complement, and the Andreotti--Frankel--Hamm CW-dimension theorem. The packaged verifier checks the finite incidence and Euler arithmetic exactly.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to the surface case. It computes ordinary integral homology and the Hopf map but does not prove asphericity or determine the second homotopy group.
title: Integral homology of the five-point parabolic very-stable surface
